name: search_code
description: Search the project source with the most deterministic engine that fits the question. engine="ast-grep": structural AST patterns with metavariables ($NAME, $$$ARGS) — use this whenever you are looking for a code *shape* rather than text. It works on this project's own Zig source too: sgconfig.yml registers a Zig grammar built by tools/grammars/build.sh, so patterns like "const $A = @import($B);" or "pub fn $N($$$A) $R { $$$B }" match real syntax and never a comment or a string. If it returns an error about the grammar, run tools/grammars/build.sh once. engine="semcode": semantic queries over an indexed C/C++/Rust tree (needs .semcode.db). engine="rg": ripgrep regex — the fallback for plain text, file names, and anything not expressible as syntax. Prefer ast-grep when the question is about code structure and rg when it is about text. Input: {"engine": "rg" | "ast-grep" | "semcode", "query": "...", "path": "."}. Returns {"ok": bool, "code": int, "stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}.
